title: Industrial Machinery & Components Manufacturing — pair dispositions
scope: Candidate universe: machinery/metal/electrical/component maker NAICS families (332x fabricated metal, 333x machinery, 3344x electronic components, 33451x industrial instruments, 335x electrical equipment, 3363x vehicle parts) × any PSC. IN = industrial product PSCs (digit families) + equipment MRO/modification/rental by makers (J0/K0/L0/N0/W0). OUT = ADS-domain product families (weapons, ammo, missiles, aircraft, ships, vehicles, defense electronics, fire control), medical/food/fuel/clothing products (homed or parked), services PSCs, already-homed pairs. Tab shows pairs ≥$100K; the bucket includes the full list.
